facts.statement: The researchers created a wireless, battery-free electrical stimulation device that uses a biodegradable conductive scaffold made with 3D printing and electrospinning.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: Daily electrical stimulation increased the release of growth factors from Schwann cells and encouraged nerve cell growth, with the strongest effects seen within 24 hours.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: In rats with a 10-millimeter gap in their sciatic nerve, the wireless system improved motor recovery, muscle health, nerve function, and nerve structure more than a scaffold alone.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The wireless system did not match the results of autograft repair for most measures, except for myelination, where it performed similarly.
facts.subject: animals
